name: Industrial Control Systems Engineer
description: Program PLCs, SCADA systems, and industrial controllers. Implement ladder logic, PID control, and safety interlocks for factory automation.
example_snippet:
program SafetyInterlock:
    shape MachineState holds:
        EmergencyStop as truth value
        GuardClosed as truth value
        MotorRunning as truth value
        Temperature as fractional number
    end shape

    action check_safety takes S as const ref MachineState produces truth value:
        if S.EmergencyStop is equal to true then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        if S.GuardClosed is equal to false then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        if S.Temperature is greater than 80.0 then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        produce success with true
    end action

    keep Press as MachineState with false and true and false and 65.0
    keep Safe as truth value
    call check_safety with Press giving Safe
    print the text "Machine safe to run: " and Safe and newline
end program
